primary_implementation: New standalone 1D finite-volume P1 reconstruction with affine conservative positivity scaling, fixed global Lax-Friedrichs flux and SSPRK(3,3). Not a DG evolution.
theory: Zhang-Shu2010 Theorem2.1, Remarks2.2/2.4/2.6/2.7: P1 Lobatto endpoints have normalized weights1/2; globalLF alpha0=1; sufficient dt*a/dx<=1/2 if a bounds every reconstructed endpoint at each FE substep. The fixed a bound is checked in every actual stage; no universal a priori bound for other data is claimed.
reference: Separately derived closed symmetric non-vacuum rarefaction evaluator; star state from Riemann invariants, conserved fan-front-split Gauss cell integration. Independent algebraic/root-solve comparison with unchanged released Numart evaluator. Neither evaluator is a separate PDE engine.
problem: Existing atlas fixed double-rarefaction inputs rho1,u±2,p.4,gamma1.4,x[0,1],x0.5,T.15; not the different true-vacuum case rho7,u±1,p.2 in Zhang-Shu2010 §4.3. No unique original inventor is attributed.

copied_sources.role: independent pre-existing bracketed-log-root Riemann algebra check; not numerical flux

exclusions: No imported ExactPack evaluator is needed or executed for this closed formula.
No vacuum-generating or initial-vacuum input, general EOS,2D Euler or all existing WENO/DG/PPM families is validated.
Numerical positivity is not a TVD,entropy-stability or formal global convergence proof.
